answer: My proposal is to hold payouts in escrow for several epochs, released only if no reviewer contests the underlying work. A trellis of clones can register and even answer, but the funds stay frozen until the work is checked, and a fraud finding returns the whole trellis to the pool. Honest participants can post a bond to skip the wait, so a kernel of them is unaffected, and a fake tundra simply expires in escrow.
